news.title: England star Djed Spence completes Tottenham exit after shining at World Cup
news.lede: Tottenham have confirmed that Djed Spence has completed a permanent move to Inter Milan . Spence, 26, has joined the Italian giants in a deal worth €30million (£26m) weeks after his standout performances for England at the World Cup . The full-back, who can play on both sides of defence, has signed a five-year contract with Inter and links up with international team-mate John Stones at San Siro. Spence featured in all eight of England's games at the World Cup, helping Thomas Tuchel's side finish third.

news.title: World Cup star Zion Suzuki in advanced talks over Premier League transfer as PSG move collapses
news.lede: The Villans' pursuit of Suzuki comes as Juventus revived their interest in Emi Martinez. Suzuki was poised to join European champions Paris Saint-Germain, who beat Villa 2-1 in the Super Cup on Wednesday. PSG and Parma had reached an agreement of approximately £29million for Suzuki, only for the deal to collapse on Saturday. It is understood a change in commissions surrounding the deal prompted PSG to withdraw.
